facts.claim: Grace Hotel (Auberge Collection), Imerovigli, Santorini, has a dedicated weddings page: a clifftop hotel above the caldera where the venue offers a unity ceremony mixing black and white volcanic sand, held 363 metres above sea level.

Grace Hotel wedding venues are The Villa (a 400 sq m villa with private pool, gazebo and outdoor fireplace on a split-level terrace, described by the hotel as amongst the largest in the Cyclades) and the 363 Lounge (open-air champagne lounge terrace facing the sunset). Published capacity: 363 Lounge 40 seated, 60 standing; The Villa 15 seated, 60 standing.

Grace Hotel states its wedding venue fee includes exclusive use of the selected event spaces (not the whole hotel); a room block or resort buyout is available on request through its Sales Manager, and no minimum number of rooms must be booked.

Grace Hotel requires a wedding planner for all weddings, involved at least 3 months before the date; a private lounge for the wedding party is available from 8am on the day; a DJ or live band is permitted for the reception.
Grace Hotel accommodation is deluxe rooms, suites and one villa (room count not published on the pages read). Check-in 15:00, check-out 12:00.

Canaves Collection, Oia, Santorini, has a weddings page covering weddings and elopements across its hotels; its wedding enquiry form lists ceremony types Religious, Civil, Symbolic and Vow Renewal (form options, not a confirmation that each is legal on site).

Canaves wedding ceremony venues as published: Panorama Balcony at Canaves Oia Suites up to 30 guests; Veranda rooftop at Canaves Sunday up to 40 guests with 180-degree caldera views; Sunset Terrace at Canaves Epitome up to 25 guests.
facts.conflicts: Sunset Terrace is 25 guests on the weddings page but 100 theatre / 80 banquet / 100 reception on the Exclusives & Buyouts page (likely ceremony vs buyout layouts).

facts.claim: Canaves offers full-property buyouts: Canaves Epitome 53 rooms, max 170 guests; Canaves Ena 18 rooms, max 45; Canaves Oia Suites 48 rooms, max 120; Canaves Sunday 10 rooms, max 22.

Canaves Epitome, described as carved from volcanic rock and ideal for full-property buyouts, lists Outdoor Gardens at 180 theatre / 250 banquet / 280 reception and the Omnia Pool Area at 100 theatre / 150 banquet / 250 reception.

Santa Marina, a Luxury Collection Resort, Mykonos, has a Weddings & Celebrations page: venues with Aegean views, a traditional whitewashed stone chapel on site, and an in-house team of wedding planners; a wedding brochure and event menus are published as PDFs.

Santa Marina sits on a private peninsula at the southern tip of Ornos Bay, Mykonos, with rooms, suites and villas, a private sandy beach and the Ginkgo Spa, minutes from Mykonos Town (room count not published on the pages read).

Myconian Collection (Elia, Mykonos) hosts weddings: vows in a small whitewashed chapel followed by a beach reception or a restaurant reception; its Elia hotels are named as the wedding hotels; it assists with ceremonies of all denominations and has certified halal and kosher kitchens.
Myconian Collection's Horizons Ballroom is a semi-open, covered space that seats 270 at round tables, 380 to 400 in banquet layout and up to 550 for cocktails; it can be divided into four sections.
facts.conflicts: The page does not say which Elia hotel houses the ballroom; confirm with the venue.

facts.claim: Myconian Collection's guest transfer fleet includes limousines, 15-seat limo minibuses and 40-seat limo mini-coaches; it can arrange fireworks over the bay.
Royal Myconian (Myconian Collection, Elia) has a Weddings & Events page with an events team, plus a pool terrace and a private spot on Elia Beach.
Cavo Tagoo Mykonos' official FAQ says the pool and lounge area may be reserved for private events subject to hotel approval; no weddings page or wedding wording was found in its site navigation.
Cavo Tagoo Mykonos FAQ: daily ferry routes connect Mykonos with other Cycladic islands such as Santorini, Paros and Naxos; private yacht or speedboat transfers can be arranged.
facts.conflicts: Hotel source, not a ferry operator or government source; batch C should confirm inter-island ferry facts from an official source.

facts.claim: Elounda Beach Hotel & Villas (Elounda, Crete) says it and its sister Elounda Bay Palace are a choice for weddings, christenings, vows exchange, gala dinners and private celebrations, with waterfront villas and suites that have their own private decks and pools.

Elounda Beach lists a private chapel for weddings and christenings. Its indicative wedding package includes a dedicated consultant, legal and licence paperwork, a civil or religious ceremony outside the hotel's church or at another place of the couple's choice (civil weddings), and an escorted transfer to the authorities to register the wedding.

Elounda Beach publishes banquet capacities per venue: Artemis 180 indoor and 430 outdoor; Dionysos 100 indoor and 300 outdoor; Argonaut 180 outdoor. At the adjacent Elounda Bay Palace, Aretoussa seats 300 indoor and 500 outdoor for a banquet.
Elounda Beach's wedding services include a firework show, traditional Cretan lyre music during the ceremony, bridal treatments and hairdresser facilities at the hotel, and limo transfer for guests.
Melenos Art Boutique Hotel sits in the heart of the village of Lindos, Rhodes, next to the Lindos acropolis, and its own site has a weddings page with in-house wedding coordinators.

Melenos says it can arrange a civil ceremony, a symbolic ceremony or a traditional Orthodox wedding, and its wedding planner handles the legal documents and marriage licence registration; official witnesses can be provided on request.

Melenos suggests reserving the entire hotel for a minimum of three nights for a wedding, with additional guests accommodated at the Melenos Apartments and Studios in the village, a 10 minute walk from the hotel.

Melenos lists optional wedding services including a rehearsal dinner on the Melenos terrace, a welcome cocktail party, a private boat excursion, live music and donkeys to carry the couple to the ceremony.
Grecotel Corfu Imperial (Kommeno Peninsula, Corfu) offers weddings and vow renewals with dedicated wedding specialists.
Corfu Imperial names three wedding settings: Yali Waterfront Restaurant on a deck above the water, Aristos Restaurant for up to 50 guests, and the private island 'Nissaki' for up to 50 guests.

Grecotel's wedding page lists Corfu Imperial as a wedding destination, plus Villa Medusa on the Kommeno Peninsula (6 bedrooms, 2 private pools, a path to the beach) for intimate celebrations and Danilia, a private traditional village in Corfu, for feasts.

Daios Cove's official site navigation has no weddings page (/weddings returns 404); its conferences page describes private or corporate functions, two ballrooms and an outdoor event area overlooking the sea, but does not mention weddings.
bluepalace.gr now redirects to phaeablue.com (Phāea Blue, Elounda); the /weddings URL returns 404 and the site navigation and experiences page list no weddings.

Porto Zante Villas & Spa (Zakynthos) has no weddings page (/weddings returns 404) and its navigation and facilities page do not mention weddings or whole-resort exclusive use; its largest villas list 8 to 14 occupancy.

Four Seasons Astir Palace Hotel Athens has a dedicated weddings page: it describes itself as an Athens wedding hotel providing event coordination for ceremonies and receptions on the Athenian Riviera, with waterfront venues across a 30-hectare (75-acre) estate and events from 10 to 1,000 guests.

Four Seasons Astir Palace Athens says its event specialists handle banquet menus, seating and guest room blocks, has an in-house wedding planner, offers intimate indoor spaces and a grand outdoor terrace that can host hundreds in privacy, and overlooks the Saronic Gulf; it also offers vow renewals.
Four Seasons Astir Palace Athens describes itself as a beachfront resort about 30 minutes from Athens' historic centre, with private beach access offered within multi-day wedding itineraries.

Grand Resort Lagonissi's official site has a 'Weddings & Celebrations' section (overview, celebrations, and 'Weddings & Ceremonies' pages); the resort sits on a 72-acre private peninsula on the Athenian Riviera overlooking the Saronic Gulf, with 5.2 km of coastline and 16 private beaches.

Grand Resort Lagonissi states it is about 20 minutes from Athens International Airport, about 45 minutes from central Athens and 50 to 60 minutes from the port of Piraeus; accommodation ranges from main-building rooms to bungalows, suites with private pools and villas, with 7 restaurants and 3 bars.

Amanzoe (Agios Panteleimonas, Kranidi, Argolida, near Porto Heli, east Peloponnese) states it is a 2.5-hour drive from Athens International Airport; pavilions and villas all have private pools, with a beach club, and the resort links to a 'celebrations and events' page. Amanzoe closes for the season on 14 November 2026 and reopens on 24 March 2027.

As at November 2026, Smartraveller's 'Getting married overseas' page (last updated 18/08/2026) says some countries ask you to prove you are not already married; the most common documents are a Certificate of No Impediment to Marriage (CNI) and registry certificates; DFAT can issue a CNI in Australia but some local authorities only accept CNIs issued in their country, so ask the destination's embassy whether you need one, where to get it and whether it needs an apostille. The Wedded Advisor confirms current requirements.

As at November 2026, Smartraveller says an overseas marriage cannot be registered in Australia but in most cases is legally recognised if it was valid where it took place and would have been valid under Australian law; a foreign marriage certificate is usually accepted as proof of marriage but may not prove a name change; talk to a lawyer to confirm validity. The Wedded Advisor confirms current requirements.

Grand Resort Lagonissi's 'Weddings & Ceremonies' page names five wedding venues on the resort: Uranus (open-air terrace for a 'Grand Wedding Gala' at sunset), Veghera (on the south water edge of the peninsula), La Piscina (garden and pool), Aphrodite (dinner with Mediterranean views) and Villa Elounda (an intimate garden a few steps from a private sandy beach). Services listed include Events team wedding assistance, a honeymoon suite and bridal beauty treatments.

Costa Navarino (south-west Peloponnese, Messinia) has a weddings page: traditional religious marriages can be held at the chapel of St Samson within Navarino Dunes or at St Eleni at Navarino Agora; civil ceremonies can be arranged on request in town halls or outdoors (beach, boat, hilltop, beside a stream).

Costa Navarino's weddings page lists wedding venues at The Romanos, a Luxury Collection Resort (in Navarino Dunes among olive groves and vineyards by the Ionian Sea), W Costa Navarino (on a sandy beach) and Mandarin Oriental, Costa Navarino (eight indoor and outdoor spaces from 62 sqm to 868 sqm), and refers to four 5-star resorts in total.

Amanzoe's celebrations page states it 'hosts weddings of all sizes' between hills and the Aegean, with contemporary architecture inspired by ancient design, indoor and outdoor weddings, and proposals on request.

As at November 2026, the Australian Embassy in Athens lists among its notarial services witnessing application forms for, and issuing, Certificates of No Impediment (CNI) and witnessing notices of intended marriage; an appointment is needed (CNI documents can be submitted by post) and CNIs are available for collection within two working days. The Embassy does not provide legal advice. The Wedded Advisor confirms current requirements.

As at November 2026, Smartraveller's Greece page (updated 30 September 2026, re-read live 2026-11-09) says wildfires occur in the extended summer period from June to September, burning near cities and tourist locations on the mainland and the islands and prompting evacuations; heatwaves are frequent over the summer months. Advice level: exercise normal safety precautions.

Smartraveller's Greece page (sea travel) says ferries and large catamarans carry most visitors to the Greek islands; in the May to October tourist season expect high temperatures and large crowds at popular seaports; ferry services can be delayed or cancelled in bad weather, mainly due to strong winds; you usually carry your own luggage up and down stairs; arrange a coach or taxi pick-up in advance.

One&Only Aesthesis (Leof. Poseidonos 110, Glyfada) describes itself as set in a private pine grove on the shores of Glyfada, 30 minutes from central Athens, and offers weddings: ceremonies in its traditional white Greek chapel, then celebrations at beachfront venues.

One&Only Aesthesis publishes event capacities: Agora Ballroom 140 seated / 200 standing; Agora Veranda 250 seated / 500 standing; Horizon Rooftop 70 standing; Mystiko Beach (private cove), Villa One (two-bedroom villa with pool) and Manko on request. The nearby Asteria Domus halls (810 seated) are independently operated, not part of the resort.
One&Only Aesthesis accommodation types listed on its official site are rooms, bungalows, suites, villas and private villa rentals; check-in 15:00, check-out 12:00.

Kokotos Estate (Ktima G. Kokotou; www.ktimakokotou.gr now redirects to kokotosestate.gr) describes itself as a family winery in Stamata, Attica, 'an exceptional wine destination close to Athens', and its site menu has 'Private events' and 'Receptions' pages (content not read in this run).

Athens International Airport says 24-hour express buses connect the airport with central Athens and the port of Piraeus, and metro and suburban rail also run to central Athens; SKY express and Aegean are promoted as domestic carriers (SKY express 'the largest network in Greece').

Athens International Airport states that since 30 March 2026 the EU Entry/Exit System (EES) is fully deployed for third-country nationals and passport control may involve long waits; it advises arriving at least 2.5 hours before departure.

One&Only Aesthesis's weddings page lists an on-resort chapel for ceremonies and vow exchanges, plus Agora Ballroom (140 seated / 200 standing), Agora Veranda (300 seated / 800 standing), Sunset Bar (wedding ceremony 150 seated / 300 standing) and Horizon Rooftop (100 standing); the chapel, Sunset Bar and Horizon Rooftop operate May to September. A dedicated team ('Dream Weavers') organises bouquets, hair and beauty and cocktails.
facts.conflicts: The resort's own events page gives Agora Veranda 250 seated / 500 standing and Horizon Rooftop 70 standing (fact_216); the weddings page gives 300/800 and 100. The weddings page also repeats 300/800 for Nous Boardroom and Asteria Domus, which looks like a template error. Use the venue's written confirmation.

facts.claim: Kokotos Estate's 'Receptions' page says the estate hosts weddings and other social events and offers an open-air space for 500 seated / 1,000 standing, an indoor space for 450 seated / 800 standing, a smaller indoor space for 80 seated / 120 standing, a chapel, its own wines, valet parking, access for guests with special needs, a room for the couple and a generator. No guest rooms are listed.

Visit Greece (official Greek tourism site) says Greece has a Mediterranean climate with plenty of sunshine and limited rainfall, and that in summer the dry hot days are cooled by seasonal winds called the meltemi (data credited to the National Observatory of Athens).

Wedding legal options in brief, combined from venue and government sources: Costa Navarino states traditional religious (Orthodox chapel) marriages and civil ceremonies (town halls or outdoors, on request); One&Only Aesthesis and Kokotos Estate have chapels on site. Whether a chapel ceremony is legally binding for non-Orthodox couples, and the documents Greece requires (CNI from the Australian Embassy Athens, apostilles, translations), are confirmed per couple. As at November 2026; the Wedded Advisor confirms current requirements.

Katikies Hotels' events page says its hotels in Santorini and Mykonos host weddings, with an events and concierge team that plans and manages every detail, and lists micro weddings as a package idea. Its Santorini properties are Katikies Santorini (Oia), Katikies Chromata (Imerovigli) and Katikies Garden (Fira).

Katikies publishes capacities for venues it marks as ideal for wedding ceremonies: Botrini's Restaurant at Katikies Santorini 60 seated / 100 standing; Selene Restaurant at Katikies Garden 55 seated outside / 150 standing; St. Joseph Wine Cave at Katikies Garden 36 seated / 50 standing; Garden Pool Bar 36 seated / 100 standing; Chromata Pool Bar area 40-50 seated / 50 standing; Koukoumavlos Restaurant Deck 20 seated / 50 standing; Katikies Lounge at Chromata 20 seated / 30 standing.

Katikies' event enquiry form lists 'Hotel Take over' as an event type alongside weddings. At Katikies Mykonos (Agios Ioannis) the Upper deck seats 50 / 100 standing and is marked ideal for wedding ceremonies.

Mystique, a Luxury Collection Hotel, is carved into the caldera cliffs at Oia, Santorini. Its weddings page says its wedding specialists organise the wedding, its venues serve as the ceremony backdrop and the team will find the setting to suit the couple; it offers getting-ready suites and Elios Spa treatments.

Mystique's homepage lists eight named suites and villas (including Holistic, Mystery and Secrecy villas) and describes the hotel as a favoured destination for honeymoons with an understated, exclusive feel.

Angsana Corfu Resort & Spa (11th km Kerkyra to Lefkimi road, Corfu) has a Weddings & Honeymoons page offering vows, anniversaries, proposals and honeymoons, a 2026 wedding brochure, a real weddings page and a wedding proposal request form.

Angsana Corfu's wedding venues page lists 196 hotel accommodations, 345 sqm total event space and 'meet and feed' 200, with named venues Oribu Garden, Vertigo Sky Bar, Starboard Terrace, Emerald Beach, Amalia Hall, Foyer Amalia and three restaurants (Oribu, Sofrito, Ruen Romsai). Per-venue capacities are not shown.

Atrium Prestige (Atrium Hotels & Resorts, south Rhodes) has a weddings page offering ceremonies on a private beach, with named venues: the Amphitheater a few steps from the beach (described as ideal for larger events), the private Tsambika chapel reached across a bridge, Lachania Beach, the Golden Dome, the Panoramic Terrace, Thallassa restaurant for receptions and Kalithea main bar for the party.

Atrium Prestige says its wedding specialist assists couples seeking a civil ceremony with the arrangements to obtain a marriage licence, and that symbolic ceremonies, elopements and vow renewals are offered. The private chapel is presented for 'a more traditional wedding ceremony'.

Atrium Prestige's wedding services include a bridal villa with sea view and private pool for getting ready, local flowers, bridal make-up and hair, an on-site photographer, chef menu tasting, DJ or live music (violin, guitar or bouzouki) and a fireworks display over the sea. Per-venue capacities are not published.
Lindos Blu's official page (now on blucollection.gr) lists about, accommodation, gastronomy, wellness, experience and location pages but no weddings or events page.

Domes of Corfu (Glyfada, 233 rooms) and Domes of Elounda (Crete, 175 suites, residences and villas) official sites list events and happenings pages but no weddings page; both describe themselves as family-friendly resorts.

The fetch of www.capsis.com (expected official domain of Out of the Blue Capsis Elite Resort) redirected to an unrelated gaming site, so the venue's official site could not be confirmed. Kontokali Bay's homepage (kontokalibay.gr) shows no weddings or events link; Minos Beach's /weddings URL returned a 404 page.
Sani Resort (Halkidiki) has a dedicated weddings page describing weddings in Greece at a luxury five-star resort, with an in-house wedding planner who handles arrangements, accommodation and cuisine.

Sani Resort's wedding page says it has space to host up to 30 guests, including children, and its wedding special includes administration and reservation of the wedding date and time at the local Town Hall.

Sani Resort lists two ceremony settings: the courtyard of Sani Church, a stone-built Greek church in the resort grounds near Sani Marina, and Ammos Beach facing the Aegean Sea near Sani Hill; indoor and outdoor reception venues include restaurants and bars, many overlooking the Aegean, subject to request and availability.

Danai Beach Resort (Halkidiki) says every event at the resort is tailor-made, including weddings, with a team of event planners who create itineraries for multiple-day celebrations across venues around the resort.

Danai Beach Resort lists wedding backdrops at the beach, the vineyard in an evergreen garden and at the bottom of a marble staircase at one of its villas, and says it provides photographers, florists, music entertainment (live DJs, bands, jazz ensembles) plus technical equipment, lighting and stage.
Danai Beach Resort says it occupies a private area of 40,000 square metres with lush gardens.

The Ikos Resorts weddings page describes weddings at Ikos Aria on Kos only (up to 30 guests' accommodation, Town Hall civil wedding coordination); it does not mention weddings at Ikos Oceania in Halkidiki.

insider_details.detail: Exclusive use on Santorini usually means the event space, not the hotel. Grace Hotel's venue fee covers exclusive use of the chosen spaces only, with a resort buyout quoted separately; Canaves sells full-property buyouts hotel by hotel. Ask each venue which one is being quoted.

Caldera terraces are small. Published ceremony capacities in Oia and Imerovigli run 25 to 40 seated, so a 100-plus guest list needs a garden or pool area (Canaves Epitome) or a Mykonos ballroom-scale venue (Myconian Collection).
Grace Hotel requires an outside wedding planner engaged at least 3 months out, so build that lead time into the booking timeline.

For big Mykonos guest lists, check what transfers the venue runs itself: Myconian Collection lists 15-seat minibuses and 40-seat coaches, which simplifies moving guests between Elia and the ceremony site.

A chapel on site removes a transfer on the day: Santa Marina and Myconian Collection both describe a whitewashed chapel; confirm in writing whether a religious ceremony can be legally performed there.

Melenos is one of the few venues that frames the wedding as a whole-hotel booking: it suggests taking the entire hotel for at least three nights and housing extra guests in its village apartments a 10 minute walk away, so plan the guest list around that split.

Corfu Imperial's two named private settings, Aristos and the islet Nissaki, each top out at 50 guests, so it suits a smaller guest list; larger groups should ask what the Yali deck holds before falling for the venue.

Elounda Beach and Elounda Bay Palace publish banquet capacities venue by venue, and the largest figures are outdoor ones, so the indoor number for the chosen space is the one to plan the rain plan around.
Melenos and Elounda Beach both say their teams handle the legal paperwork, but the ceremony type still has to be confirmed in writing for each venue before dates are locked.

Athens Riviera venues sit close to the airport, which suits a guest list flying in from Australia: Grand Resort Lagonissi says it is about 20 minutes from Athens International Airport, while Four Seasons Astir Palace and One&Only Aesthesis each say about 30 minutes from central Athens. Amanzoe, by contrast, says it is a 2.5-hour drive from the airport, so plan a coach in daylight and a rest day.

Several outdoor spaces only run in summer. At One&Only Aesthesis the chapel, Sunset Bar and Horizon Rooftop operate May to September, which overlaps with Smartraveller's June to September wildfire period and summer heatwaves, so ask each venue for its indoor plan (Agora Ballroom at Aesthesis, for example) as the heat and fire fallback.

For island add-ons, build ferry slack into the itinerary: Smartraveller says ferries can be delayed or cancelled mainly due to strong winds, Visit Greece says summer is the meltemi season, and guests usually carry their own luggage on board. Book coach pick-ups at the port in advance.

Leave time for the Athens airport exit and departure: the airport says the EU Entry/Exit System is fully deployed for non-EU travellers since 30 March 2026 and advises arriving 2.5 hours before departure, so do not schedule a welcome event too close to a long-haul landing.

Big guest lists favour the mainland: Kokotos Estate publishes 500 seated outdoors and Four Seasons Astir Palace says up to 1,000 guests, but Kokotos lists no bedrooms, so guests need a hotel block in Athens and transfers.

Start CNI paperwork early: the Australian Embassy Athens issues CNIs by appointment or post with collection in about two working days, but Smartraveller says some authorities only accept CNIs issued in their own country, so the Wedded Advisor confirms which document Greece accepts before you book flights.

On Santorini the Katikies group splits venues across three hotels in Oia, Imerovigli and Fira, so a ceremony at the Fira garden hotel and drinks at an Oia caldera venue means a cross-island transfer; keep ceremony and reception at one hotel where you can.

Caldera hotels publish small numbers: most Katikies ceremony spaces seat 20 to 60, so a Santorini cliff-edge wedding suits guest lists under about 60 seated, with larger groups needing the Fira garden venue (150 standing).

Atrium Prestige on Rhodes is one of the few resorts in this list to say on its own site that it helps with the civil marriage licence, which matters for Australians wanting a legal ceremony rather than a symbolic one; still confirm the paperwork route with the Wedded Advisor.

Angsana Corfu publishes a resort-level 200 figure and 196 rooms, so a guest block of most invitees on site is realistic, but ask which named venue holds the seated dinner before setting the guest list.

Halkidiki resorts publish small wedding numbers, not ballroom figures: Sani Resort says its wedding offer has space for up to 30 guests including children, so a larger Australian guest list needs the capacity confirmed in writing before deposits.

For a civil ceremony at Sani Resort the legal part happens at the local Town Hall, which the resort's wedding team books, so build transport to and from the Town Hall into the day's timeline before a beach or church-courtyard celebration.

Danai Beach Resort plans multi-day itineraries across beach, vineyard garden and villa staircase settings and supplies music, lighting and stage in-house, which suits a three-day destination wedding run from one base.

Batch B confirmed 3 of 9 candidates (Elounda Beach, Melenos Lindos, Corfu Imperial). Zakynthos has no verified venue. Lindian Village and Domes Miramare sites returned placeholders to the fetch tool and could be re-tried with another fetcher.
Greek-side civil marriage requirements are not sourced from a government page; legal section should stay at CNI plus recognition level, or a Greek government source be added.

Batch D confirmed 4 venues (Katikies, Mystique, Angsana Corfu, Atrium Prestige), bringing the total to 17 of 20. Vedema, Andronis and Abaton failed to load and Minos Beach's homepage fetch was declined; these could be retried with another fetcher. Mystique's page is thin (no capacity or ceremony type).
Batch E confirmed 2 venues (Sani Resort, Danai Beach Resort), bringing the total to 15 of 20. Athens and Peloponnese candidates failed to load in the time box.
